title: A Failed Glue Became The Post-it Note 📝
caption:
A failed glue became one of the best selling office products 📝
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1968 a 3M chemist tried to make a super strong adhesive and made a weak, reusable one instead. Years later a colleague who kept losing his hymn book bookmark realised it was perfect. 3M launched the Post-it note in 1980.
What colour would you pick? 👇
first_comment: Yellow only because the lab had scrap yellow paper. Best accident ever? 📝👇
